questions.q_en: The average of 15 numbers is 84. The average of the first 6 numbers is 70. The average of the next 6 numbers is 20% more than the average of the first 6 numbers. The 13th number is 8 more than the 15th number, and the 14th number is 2 less than the 15th number. What is the average of the 13th and 14th numbers?
questions.q_hi: 15 संख्याओं का औसत 84 है। पहली 6 संख्याओं का औसत 70 है। अगली 6 संख्याओं का औसत, पहली 6 संख्याओं के औसत से 20% अधिक है। 13वीं संख्या, 15वीं संख्या से 8 अधिक है, और 14वीं संख्या, 15वीं संख्या से 2 कम है। 13वीं और 14वीं संख्याओं का औसत क्या है?
options_en: 110
112
113
115
options_hi: 110
112
113
115
questions.solution_en:
Total Sum = 15 × 84 = 1260
Sum of first 6 numbers = 6 × 70 = 420
Sum of next six numbers = 70 × 6/5 × 6 = 504
Sum of last three = 1260 - (420 + 504) = 1260 - 924 = 336

Let 15th num be x.
13th = x + 8
14th = x - 2
x + (x + 8) + (x - 2) = 336
3x + 6 = 336
3x = 330
x = 110

Avg of 13th & 14th = (x + 8 + x - 2)/2 = (2x + 6)/2
⇒ x + 3 = 113
questions.solution_hi:
कुल योग = 15 × 84 = 1260

पहले 6 अंकों का योग = 6 × 70 = 420

अगले छह अंकों का योग = 70 × 6/5 × 6 = 504

अंतिम तीन अंकों का योग = 1260 - (420 + 504) = 1260 - 924 = 336

मान लीजिए 15वाँ अंक x है।

13वाँ = x + 8

14वाँ = x - 2

x + (x + 8) + (x - 2) = 336

3x + 6 = 336

3x = 330

x = 110

13वें और 14वें अंक का औसत = (x + 8 + x - 2)/2 = (2x + 6)/2

⇒ x + 3 = 113

questions.q_en: There are 5 consecutive even numbers X₁, X₂, X₃, X₄, X₅ and 4 consecutive odd numbers Y₁, Y₂, Y₃, Y₄. The average of the even numbers is 6 more than the average of the odd numbers. If the sum of the even numbers is 34 more than the sum of the odd numbers, find the average of the odd numbers.

4

6

4

questions.solution_en:
Sₑ = Sum of evens
Sₒ = Sum of odds

A.T.Q.
Sₑ = Sₒ + 34 ---(I)
Sₑ/5 = Sₒ/4 + 6
4Sₑ = 5Sₒ + 120 --(II)

Sₒ = 16,
Average = 16/4 = 4
questions.solution_hi:
Sₑ = सम संख्याओं का योग

Sₒ = विषम संख्याओं का योग

प्रश्न के अनुसार:

4Sₑ = 5Sₒ + 120 --(II)

Sₒ = 16,

औसत = 16/4 = 4

If each no. is doubled the squared

questions.q_en: The average of 10 numbers is 70. The difference between the highest and lowest number is 44. If the highest number is excluded, the average of the remaining 9 numbers drops by 2. What is the lowest number?

questions.q_en:
Which of the following statements is/are true?

I. The average of 6 numbers is 48. If one number is removed, the average of the remaining 5 numbers becomes 46, so the removed number is 58.

II. If instead, the removed number was 42, the average of the remaining 5 numbers would be 49.2.
questions.q_hi:
निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा/कौन-से कथन सत्य है/हैं?

I. 6 संख्याओं का औसत 48 है। यदि एक संख्या हटा दी जाए, तो शेष 5 संख्याओं का औसत 46 हो जाता है; अतः हटाई गई संख्या 58 है।

II. यदि इसके स्थान पर, हटाई गई संख्या 42 होती, तो शेष 5 संख्याओं का औसत 49.2 होता।
options_en: Only I
Only II
Both I and II
Neither I nor II
options_hi: केवल 1
केवल II
I और II दोनों
न तो I और न ही II
questions.solution_en:
(I)(6×48-x)/5=46

x=58 (True)

(II) (6×48-42)/5=49.2 (True)
